description: This file defines the MessageOnlyLogFilter class, which implements the LogNode interface. It filters log messages to only pass the message content without metadata or additional info, useful for on-screen log output or simplified logging.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A LogNode implementation that filters logs to only output the message content.

methods.description: Constructor that sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.description: Filters the log message to only pass the message content to the next node.

methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.
